curation.notes: Single-molecule FRET-based molecular force sensor (MFS; spider-silk-derived (GPGGA)5 peptide spring with AF555/AF647) anchored via monovalent streptavidin-His6 to gel-phase (DPPC) or fluid (POPC) supported lipid bilayers and coupled to pMHC (IEk/MCC, IEk/AEP) or H57 scFv, imaged by TIRF under murine CD4+ T-cells (5c.c7 and AND TCR-transgenic). Also measures TCR:pMHC bond lifetimes by smFRET at 23 and 27 °C and calcium flux; no external force probe.

temperature.note: stated for smFRET bond-lifetime measurements; temperature for force measurements not stated

evidence.snippet: Lifetimes were recorded at 23 °C and 27 °C for various receptor:ligand pairs.
MFS peptide (biotin-N-GGCGS(GPGGA)5GGKYGGS-K(ε-N3)), MFSC peptide (biotin-N-GGGGS(GPGGA)5GGKYCGS-K(ε-N3)), and MFS0 peptide (biotin-N-GGGGS (GPGGA)5 GGKYG GS-K(ε-N3))
